report.explanation: Payment shows elevated latency (p95 1250ms) and 504 downstream_deadline_exceeded logs, with gateway call-payment spans erroring at ~1969ms. However, gateway metrics are healthy (error_rate 0.0012, p95 72ms, no timeouts) and logs show 200/ok, contradicting the alert. Payment's own dependency_timeouts and db_pool_waiters are 0, so no bounded cause is established. Deployment record alone cannot prove causation. Handing off.
missing_evidence: Payment downstream dependency latency/error telemetry to identify the slow dependency
Gateway-side error-rate and latency metrics covering the same window as the erroring traces
Clarification of which service the alert's error-rate/latency threshold actually fired on
Payment span-level breakdown showing where the 1050ms authorize time is spent
